# ADR-3055: A05: Wildcard CORS credential mode for API 7

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Wildcard plus credentials is an unsafe browser combo.

## Decision

APIs MUST NOT enable a wildcard CORS credential mode for API 7 (A05-7) unless an exception is explicitly documented.

## Consequences

Origins are enumerated explicitly.
